descriptionPlain:
Position Overview:
As Senior Applications Engineer you will work directly with external customers and engineering groups within Velo3D to develop innovative and novel projects for additively manufactured production hardware. You will work closely with process development, hardware, and software engineering teams to refine existing systems and develop new capabilities based on customer need. You will support sales in finding and developing business cases that exploit our advanced technology.
description:
Position Overview:
As Senior Applications Engineer you will work directly with external customers and engineering groups within Velo3D to develop innovative and novel projects for additively manufactured production hardware. You will work closely with process development, hardware, and software engineering teams to refine existing systems and develop new capabilities based on customer need. You will support sales in finding and developing business cases that exploit our advanced technology.

lists.content:
• Prepare and optimize files for printing using Velo3D’s Flow software with a full value stream understanding of engineering requirements: printing, post-processing, lead times, and economic implications. 
  • Design, modify, and analyze complex geometries in CAD software. 
  • Interact and communicate directly with customers professionally and effectively and generate proper customer feedback to direct internal development. 
  • Perform highly technical hands-on tasks independently on and off-site for extended periods of time. 
  • Ensure customer production success via training and educating customers on Velo3D software, technology applications, and design guidelines. 
  • Operate metal additive manufacturing machines safely. Always wear appropriate PPE and obey safety protocols. Machines pose hazards associated with lasers, electronics, mechanical devices, and metal powder. 
  • Lift heavy metal parts and associated equipment up to 50 lbs. 
  • Expected travel 10-20% of the time to customer sites and on-site to Fremont. 
  • Work effectively with teams across multiple departments on technical projects. 
  • Troubleshoot software and hardware anomalies in the system using monitoring software, machine schematics, written procedures, and internal support. 
  • Maintain strong organizational skills with regards to documentation, software analysis, and project management.

• Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical or Aerospace Engineering, Material Science or related field.
  • 3-4 years of experience
  • Customer facing engineering roles. 
  • Metal additive manufacturing design, manufacturing, or production. 
  • CAD expertise (Solidworks, Siemens NX, AutoCAD, CATIA, etc.). 
  • Hands on experience with machine tools: CNC machining, semiconductor, additive manufacturing, heavy lab, or other related equipment. 
  • Dealt with critical or regulated industries like aerospace, defense, semiconductor, etc.

descriptionPlain:
POSITION OVERVIEW: 
 
As a Business Development Account Manager, you will work as the account manager for target customers to lead innovative programs and applications in additive manufacturing from early concept to full-scale production. You will work closely with manufacturing and engineering teams at target accounts to be their dedicated Velo technical engineer and resource. You will also work with Velo Applications Engineering and Field Management on difficult part production challenges and execution logistics to expedite the target account’s production adoption of Velo3D’s end-to-end solution manufacturing process.
description:
POSITION OVERVIEW: 
 
As a Business Development Account Manager, you will work as the account manager for target customers to lead innovative programs and applications in additive manufacturing from early concept to full-scale production. You will work closely with manufacturing and engineering teams at target accounts to be their dedicated Velo technical engineer and resource. You will also work with Velo Applications Engineering and Field Management on difficult part production challenges and execution logistics to expedite the target account’s production adoption of Velo3D’s end-to-end solution manufacturing process.

lists.content:
• Demonstrate the ability to manage and guide the target account through a noticeable increase in demand generated on Sapphire systems.
  • Demonstrate the ability for the target account to view you as their go-to Velo technical engineer for current and future programs and applications
    •

• Work in a fast-paced, growing company to lead target accounts into manufacturing production using Velo3D’s end-to-end manufacturing solution.
  • Take ownership of target accounts through education and project/program management of all aspects for critical programs and applications from the early design phase and then from the prototype phase into full-scale production.
  • Ability to leverage previous experiences in design and manufacturing engineering to help target accounts visualize a manufacturing path forward to the final desired production manufacturing plan.    
  • Design, modify, and analyze complex geometries in CAD and use Velo’s print preparation software to obtain estimated print times and costing quotes to present to target accounts.
  • Advanced problem solving and conflict resolution of complex and multi-entity situations, including but not limited to internal engineering teams, external engineering/manufacturing teams, and external customers/Contract Manufacturers (CMs) operating a Velo Sapphire.
  • Ability to document statement of work and customer acceptance criteria to communicate externally and internally
  • Educate customers on known Velo3D part design allowables, including understanding physical and economic implications that could present themselves with printing vs. incumbent mfg. process.
  • Consult customers on potential design optimization and challenges for desired part geometries and effectively communicate this both visually and verbally.
  • Work with Applications Engineering on parts and applications that are not part of the current design allowables by effectively communicating the problem statement.
  • Work closely and effectively with teams across multiple departments on technical projects.
  • Maintain strong organizational skills concerning documentation, software analysis, and project management.
• Required: Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical or Aerospace Engineering, Material Science, or related field.

• The experience needed involves...
    • Required:  
  • Industry experience in design engineering and manufacturing processes (AM, casting, machining, forging, etc.)
  • Completion of projects that started from early phase development and moved into production
  • Ability to self-motivate and manage complex projects to conclusion 
  • Efficient and effective sales and account management skills
  • Customer-facing and project/program management skills. 
  • CAD software design (Solidworks, Siemens NX, AutoCAD, CATIA)
    • Desired:
  • Experience with generative design tools (Altair Inspire, nTopology Element)

• Driven by Results and Impact to Customer
  • Takes ownership and responsibility
  • High Bandwidth
  • Responsiveness
  • Hands-on approach 
  • Attention to detail/focus on quality
  • Required: US Citizen or a Green Card holder (mandatory for ITAR)
  • Ability to work within a Team
